information:
Så er der konkurrence på AMAGER!
Konkurrencen vil følge WCA reglementet så husk at læs op på det inden, så der ikke sker misforståelser mellem judges og competitors. 

We are having a competition on AMAGER!
The competition will follow the WCA regulations so remember to read up on them so that there will  be no misunderstandings between judges and competitors.
